data.description:
## Goal
Arousal affects surprise threshold for FAST/SLOW switching.

## Changes
Modify cortical/reasoning/loom.py:
- ModeController takes phenomenological_state parameter
- High arousal lowers surprise threshold (more likely to go SLOW)
- Low arousal raises threshold (stay in FAST mode)

## Integration Formula
```python
effective_threshold = base_threshold * (1.0 - arousal * 0.5)
# High arousal (0.8) → threshold * 0.6 → more SLOW thinking
# Low arousal (0.2) → threshold * 0.9 → stay FAST
```

## Test Requirements
- test_high_arousal_triggers_slow_mode_easier()
- test_low_arousal_stays_fast()
data.title: Integrate PhenomenologicalState with Loom mode switching
